images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable painterly game material for a flat parapet roof, covering roughly a 2 metre square. Paint a quiet weathered charcoal-grey mineral roofing felt / tar membrane seen exactly perpendicular from above, completely flat with no perspective. Hand-painted environment texture with broad restrained brushwork, slate-grey and warm grey midtones, a few soft rubbed patches and faint dusty granules. Very low contrast, readable large color masses. A small minority of subtle darker repair strokes, no large cracks, no holes, no leaves, no roof edges, no fixtures, no border, no lettering, no watermark, no dramatic highlights or baked directional shadows. All four edges should tile seamlessly; keep edge detail quiet. Opaque square image, suitable under dynamic game lighting. This is a surface texture only, not a roof photograph or a complete building.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable painterly game material, a 1 metre square of lightly weathered dressed limestone used for apartment lintels, sills and a restrained stone base around 1900-1920. Exact perpendicular orthographic view of the flat material, no perspective, no building or objects. Warm pale grey / soft buff limestone with broad quiet hand-painted planes, very subtle chisel/saw traces and tiny softened chips along a few edges. Three low-contrast horizontal courses of rectangular cut blocks, staggered vertical joints, joints narrow and understated. Match a painterly architectural game palette with muted cream sash and warm red brick. No round cobbles, no rough rubble, no large cracks, no intense shadows or baked directional lighting, no text, no border or watermark. Quiet repetition with edges seamless in both directions; brushwork should remain apparent at close inspection. Opaque square texture.
